label: a
heading: To which educational agencies or institutions do these regulations apply
text: Except as otherwise noted in § 99.10, this part applies to an educational agency or institution to which funds have been made available under any program administered by the Secretary, if—

label: a.1
heading: To which educational agencies or institutions do these regulations apply
text: The educational institution provides educational services or instruction, or both, to students; or

label: a.2
heading: To which educational agencies or institutions do these regulations apply
text: The educational agency is authorized to direct and control public elementary or secondary, or postsecondary educational institutions.

label: b
heading: To which educational agencies or institutions do these regulations apply
text: This part does not apply to an educational agency or institution solely because students attending that agency or institution receive non-monetary benefits under a program referenced in paragraph (a) of this section, if no funds under that program are made available to the agency or institution.

label: c
heading: To which educational agencies or institutions do these regulations apply
text: The Secretary considers funds to be made available to an educational agency or institution of funds under one or more of the programs referenced in paragraph (a) of this section—

label: c.1
heading: To which educational agencies or institutions do these regulations apply
text: Are provided to the agency or institution by grant, cooperative agreement, contract, subgrant, or subcontract; or

label: c.2
heading: To which educational agencies or institutions do these regulations apply
text: Are provided to students attending the agency or institution and the funds may be paid to the agency or institution by those students for educational purposes, such as under the Pell Grant Program and the Guaranteed Student Loan Program (titles IVA-1 and IV-B, respectively, of the Higher Education Act of 1965, as amended).

label: d
heading: To which educational agencies or institutions do these regulations apply
text: If an educational agency or institution receives funds under one or more of the programs covered by this section, the regulations in this part apply to the recipient as a whole, including each of its components (such as a department within a university).

heading: What is the purpose of these regulations
text: The purpose of this part is to set out requirements for the protection of privacy of parents and students under section 444 of the General Education Provisions Act, as amended.

heading: What are the rights of parents
text: An educational agency or institution shall give full rights under the Act to either parent, unless the agency or institution has been provided with evidence that there is a court order, State statute, or legally binding document relating to such matters as divorce, separation, or custody that specifically revokes these rights.

label: a.1
heading: What are the rights of students
text: When a student becomes an eligible student, the rights accorded to, and consent required of, parents under this part transfer from the parents to the student.

label: a.2
heading: What are the rights of students
text: Nothing in this section prevents an educational agency or institution from disclosing education records, or personally identifiable information from education records, to a parent without the prior written consent of an eligible student if the disclosure meets the conditions in § 99.31(a)(8), § 99.31(a)(10), § 99.31(a)(15), or any other provision in § 99.31(a).

label: b
heading: What are the rights of students
text: The Act and this part do not prevent educational agencies or institutions from giving students rights in addition to those given to parents.

label: c
heading: What are the rights of students
text: An individual who is or has been a student at an educational institution and who applies for admission at another component of that institution does not have rights under this part with respect to records maintained by that other component, including records maintained in connection with the student’s application for admission, unless the student is accepted and attends that other component of the institution.

label: a.1
heading: What must an educational agency or institution include in its annual notification
text: Each educational agency or institution shall annually notify parents of students currently in attendance, or eligible students currently in attendance, of their rights under the Act and this part.

label: a.2
heading: What must an educational agency or institution include in its annual notification
text: The notice must inform parents or eligible students that they have the right to—

label: a.2.i
heading: What must an educational agency or institution include in its annual notification
text: Inspect and review the student’s education records;

label: a.2.ii
heading: What must an educational agency or institution include in its annual notification
text: Seek amendment of the student’s education records that the parent or eligible student believes to be inaccurate, misleading, or otherwise in violation of the student’s privacy rights;

label: a.2.iii
heading: What must an educational agency or institution include in its annual notification
text: Consent to disclosures of personally identifiable information contained in the student’s education records, except to the extent that the Act and § 99.31 authorize disclosure without consent; and

label: a.2.iv
heading: What must an educational agency or institution include in its annual notification
text: File with the Department a complaint under §§ 99.63 and 99.64 concerning alleged failures by the educational agency or institution to comply with the requirements of the Act and this part.

label: a.3
heading: What must an educational agency or institution include in its annual notification
text: The notice must include all of the following:

label: a.3.i
heading: What must an educational agency or institution include in its annual notification
text: The procedure for exercising the right to inspect and review education records.

label: a.3.ii
heading: What must an educational agency or institution include in its annual notification
text: The procedure for requesting amendment of records under § 99.20.

label: a.3.iii
heading: What must an educational agency or institution include in its annual notification
text: If the educational agency or institution has a policy of disclosing education records under § 99.31(a)(1), a specification of criteria for determining who constitutes a school official and what constitutes a legitimate educational interest.

label: b
heading: What must an educational agency or institution include in its annual notification
text: An educational agency or institution may provide this notice by any means that are reasonably likely to inform the parents or eligible students of their rights.

label: b.1
heading: What must an educational agency or institution include in its annual notification
text: An educational agency or institution shall effectively notify parents or eligible students who are disabled.

label: b.2
heading: What must an educational agency or institution include in its annual notification
text: An agency or institution of elementary or secondary education shall effectively notify parents who have a primary or home language other than English. (Approved by the Office of Management and Budget under control number 1880–0508)

label: a
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent required to disclose information
text: The parent or eligible student shall provide a signed and dated written consent before an educational agency or institution discloses personally identifiable information from the student’s education records, except as provided in § 99.31.

label: b
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent required to disclose information
text: The written consent must:

label: b.1
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent required to disclose information
text: Specify the records that may be disclosed;

label: b.2
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent required to disclose information
text: State the purpose of the disclosure; and

label: b.3
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent required to disclose information
text: Identify the party or class of parties to whom the disclosure may be made.

label: c
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent required to disclose information
text: When a disclosure is made under paragraph (a) of this section:

label: c.1
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent required to disclose information
text: If a parent or eligible student so requests, the educational agency or institution shall provide him or her with a copy of the records disclosed; and

label: c.2
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent required to disclose information
text: If the parent of a student who is not an eligible student so requests, the agency or institution shall provide the student with a copy of the records disclosed.

label: d
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent required to disclose information
text: ‘‘Signed and dated written consent’’ under this part may include a record and signature in electronic form that—

label: d.1
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent required to disclose information
text: Identifies and authenticates a particular person as the source of the electronic consent; and

label: d.2
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent required to disclose information
text: Indicates such person’s approval of the information contained in the electronic consent.

label: a
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent not required to disclose information
text: An educational agency or institution may disclose personally identifiable information from an education record of a student without the consent required by § 99.30 if the disclosure meets one or more of the following conditions:

label: a.1.i.A
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent not required to disclose information
text: The disclosure is to other school officials, including teachers, within the agency or institution whom the agency or institution has determined to have legitimate educational interests.

label: a.1.i.B
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent not required to disclose information
text: A contractor, consultant, volunteer, or other party to whom an agency or institution has outsourced institutional services or functions may be considered a school official under this paragraph provided that the outside party—

label: a.1.i.B.1
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent not required to disclose information
text: Performs an institutional service or function for which the agency or institution would otherwise use employees;

label: a.1.i.B.2
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent not required to disclose information
text: Is under the direct control of the agency or institution with respect to the use and maintenance of education records; and

label: a.1.i.B.3
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent not required to disclose information
text: Is subject to the requirements of § 99.33(a) governing the use and redisclosure of personally identifiable information from education records.

label: a.1.ii
heading: Under what conditions is prior consent not required to disclose information
text: An educational agency or institution must use reasonable methods to ensure that school officials obtain access to only those education records in which they have legitimate educational interests. An educational agency or institution that does not use physical or technological access controls must ensure that its administrative policy for controlling access to education records is effective and that it remains in compliance with the legitimate educational interest requirement in paragraph (a)(1)(i)(A) of this section.

label: a.1
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: An educational agency or institution must maintain a record of each request for access to and each disclosure of personally identifiable information from the education records of each student, as well as the names of State and local educational authorities and Federal officials and agencies listed in § 99.31(a)(3) that may make further disclosures of personally identifiable information from the student’s education records without consent under § 99.33(b).

label: a.2
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: The agency or institution shall maintain the record with the education records of the student as long as the records are maintained.

label: a.3
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: For each request or disclosure the record must include:

label: a.3.i
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: The parties who have requested or received personally identifiable information from the education records; and

label: a.3.ii
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: The legitimate interests the parties had in requesting or obtaining the information.

label: a.4
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: An educational agency or institution must obtain a copy of the record of further disclosures maintained under paragraph (b)(2) of this section and make it available in response to a parent’s or eligible student’s request to review the record required under paragraph (a)(1) of this section.

label: a.5
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: An educational agency or institution must record the following information when it discloses personally identifiable information from education records under the health or safety emergency exception in § 99.31(a)(10) and § 99.36:

label: a.5.i
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: The articulable and significant threat to the health or safety of a student or other individuals that formed the basis for the disclosure; and

label: a.5.ii
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: The parties to whom the agency or institution disclosed the information.

label: b.1
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: Except as provided in paragraph (b)(2) of this section, if an educational agency or institution discloses personally identifiable information from education records with the understanding authorized under § 99.33(b), the record of the disclosure required under this section must include:

label: b.1.i
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: The names of the additional parties to which the receiving party may disclose the information on behalf of the educational agency or institution; and

label: b.1.ii
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: The legitimate interests under § 99.31 which each of the additional parties has in requesting or obtaining the information.

label: b.2.i
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: A State or local educational authority or Federal official or agency listed in § 99.31(a)(3) that makes further disclosures of information from education records under § 99.33(b) must record the names of the additional parties to which it discloses information on behalf of an educational agency or institution and their legitimate interests in the information under § 99.31 if the information was received from:

label: b.2.i.A
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: An educational agency or institution that has not recorded the further disclosures under paragraph (b)(1) of this section; or

label: b.2.i.B
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: Another State or local educational authority or Federal official or agency listed in § 99.31(a)(3).

label: b.2.ii
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: A State or local educational authority or Federal official or agency that records further disclosures of information under paragraph (b)(2)(i) of this section may maintain the record by the student’s class, school, district, or other appropriate grouping rather than by the name of the student.

label: b.2.iii
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: Upon request of an educational agency or institution, a State or local educational authority or Federal official or agency listed in § 99.31(a)(3) that maintains a record of further disclosures under paragraph (b)(2)(i) of this section must provide a copy of the record of further disclosures to the educational agency or institution within a reasonable period of time not to exceed 30 days.

label: c
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: The following parties may inspect the record relating to each student:

label: c.1
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: The parent or eligible student.

label: c.2
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: The school official or his or her assistants who are responsible for the custody of the records.

label: c.3
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: Those parties authorized in § 99.31(a) (1) and (3) for the purposes of auditing the recordkeeping procedures of the educational agency or institution.

label: d
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: Paragraph (a) of this section does not apply if the request was from, or the disclosure was to:

label: d.1
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: The parent or eligible student;

label: d.2
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: A school official under § 99.31(a)(1);

label: d.3
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: A party with written consent from the parent or eligible student;

label: d.4
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: A party seeking directory information; or

label: d.5
heading: What recordkeeping requirements exist concerning requests and disclosures
text: A party seeking or receiving records in accordance with § 99.31(a)(9)(ii)(A) through (C). (Approved by the Office of Management and Budget under control number 1880–0508)

label: a.1
heading: What limitations apply to the redisclosure of information
text: An educational agency or institution may disclose personally identifiable information from an education record only on the condition that the party to whom the information is disclosed will not disclose the information to any other party without the prior consent of the parent or eligible student.

label: a.2
heading: What limitations apply to the redisclosure of information
text: The officers, employees, and agents of a party that receives information under paragraph (a)(1) of this section may use the information, but only for the purposes for which the disclosure was made.

label: b.1
heading: What limitations apply to the redisclosure of information
text: Paragraph (a) of this section does not prevent an educational agency or institution from disclosing personally identifiable information with the understanding that the party receiving the information may make further disclosures of the information on behalf of the educational agency or institution if—

label: b.1.i
heading: What limitations apply to the redisclosure of information
text: The disclosures meet the requirements of § 99.31; and

label: b.1.ii.A
heading: What limitations apply to the redisclosure of information
text: The educational agency or institution has complied with the requirements of § 99.32(b); or

label: b.1.ii.B
heading: What limitations apply to the redisclosure of information
text: A State or local educational authority or Federal official or agency listed in § 99.31(a)(3) has complied with the requirements of § 99.32(b)(2).

label: b.2
heading: What limitations apply to the redisclosure of information
text: A party that receives a court order or lawfully issued subpoena and rediscloses personally identifiable information from education records on behalf of an educational agency or institution in response to that order or subpoena under § 99.31(a)(9) must provide the notification required under § 99.31(a)(9)(ii).

label: c
heading: What limitations apply to the redisclosure of information
text: Paragraph (a) of this section does not apply to disclosures under §§ 99.31(a)(8), (9), (11), (12), (14), (15), and (16), and to information that postsecondary institutions are required to disclose under the Jeanne Clery Disclosure of Campus Security Policy and Campus Crime Statistics Act, 20 U.S.C. 1092(f) (Clery Act), to the accuser and accused regarding the outcome of any campus disciplinary proceeding brought alleging a sexual offense.

label: d
heading: What limitations apply to the redisclosure of information
text: An educational agency or institution must inform a party to whom disclosure is made of the requirements of paragraph (a) of this section except for disclosures made under §§ 99.31(a)(8), (9), (11), (12), (14), (15), and (16), and to information that postsecondary institutions are required to disclose under the Clery Act to the accuser and accused regarding the outcome of any campus disciplinary proceeding brought alleging a sexual offense.
